title: Magical Sequence Transformation
body:
A string has only the letters X and Y. You may repeatedly apply either operation, earning one coin each time:

  • replace a substring XY with YZ;
  • replace a substring YX with ZY.

Print the maximum number of coins.

Also seen as "Robot Battery Conversion" with other letters.

samples.ex: XY → YZ gives YZYX, then YX → ZY gives YZZY.
The middle Y can only move one way, so one of the two X's stays.

ref:
import sys, heapq
from collections import defaultdict, deque
sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 20)

def magical(s):
    w = s.split()[0]; xs = w.count("X")
    if xs == 0: return "0"
    if w[0] == "Y" or w[-1] == "Y" or "YY" in w: return str(xs)
    runs = [len(r) for r in w.split("Y") if r]
    return str(xs - min(runs)) if "Y" in w else "0"

print(magical(sys.stdin.read()))
